Series, seasons (1975/76 on) and game types with their uuids, plus the default ssgt

Source: R/shl.R
shl_season_filter.Rd

Wraps GET https://www.shl.se/api/sports-v2/season-series-game-types-filter of the SHL site API (www.shl.se). Unofficial use of a public source; seasons are END years (2026 = 2025/26) and are mapped to the site's ssgt uuids through /statistics-v2/layout-info.

Usage

shl_season_filter(series_uuid = NULL, season_uuid = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

series_uuid

Series uuid (SHL qQ9-bb0bzEWUk, CHL qQ9-9397drVEh). No effect on the body in the drop-one probe.

season_uuid

Season uuid; picks the default ssgt returned for that season (omit for the current season).

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON as a list.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE) with the following columns:

col_nametypedescription
kindcharacterDirectory entry kind: series, season or game_type.
codecharacterGame type code: regular, playoff, qualdown (legacy career logs: qualification).
namecharacterGame type label in Swedish: Grundserie = regular season, Slutspel = playoffs, Kvalspel nedflyttning = relegation qualification, Kvalserien = the old promotion/relegation series.
uuidcharacterGame type uuid (platform key space; regular qQ9-af37Ti40B); the gameTypeUuid param of game-schedule.
deletedlogicalSoft-delete flag of the record (false in every sample).

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the host answered 404, an empty body (gameday routes before 2023/24), a table with no rows, or the season and game type are not in layout-info. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx answer or a dead connection after retries, a non-JSON or error-envelope 200, a stats-info page that reaches count or falls short of its totalCount, or a body for another game, team, athlete or ssgt than the one asked for. fastRhockey_bad_request: a 400 / 422, a season that is not a year, or an argument outside its choices.

See also

Other SHL Functions: shl_athlete_career(), shl_athlete_details(), shl_athlete_game_log(), shl_athlete_profile(), shl_athlete_seasons(), shl_boxscore(), shl_game_header(), shl_game_overview(), shl_game_summary(), shl_last_game_day(), shl_layout_info(), shl_next_game_day(), shl_pbp(), shl_player_box(), shl_player_crosswalk(), shl_player_h2h(), shl_post_game_team_stats(), shl_roster(), shl_schedule(), shl_sites(), shl_ssgt_provider(), shl_ssgt_uuid(), shl_standings(), shl_stats_info(), shl_team(), shl_team_played_games(), shl_team_stats(), shl_team_upcoming_games()

  shl_season_filter(series_uuid = "qQ9-bb0bzEWUk", season_uuid = "xs4m9qupsi")
